notes: Keldon Raider (M20): 'When this creature enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.' The first sentence does not parse, so 'If you do' has no antecedent (CR 118.12) and is left unparsed with it (compiler._dangles_after_unparsed). It used to become the creature spell's own effect, so casting the Raider drew a card (hand 2). Casting it now draws nothing.
